resources.string: Context compaction
Summarize earlier messages when a chat gets long

When a chat with %1$s gets long, earlier messages are summarized so the chat can go on within what the model can read. This applies to the main chat and every side chat. The assistant model writes the summary by default; advanced mode under Models can pick another one.
The main model reads up to %1$sK. Compaction now starts at about %2$sK.
The main model reads up to %1$sK. Automatic compaction is off, so a very long chat may fail.
First pick a main model for %1$s under Models.
Saved for the main chat and every side chat.
Compact now
Summarize the main chat with %1$s right away. The chat then goes on from the summary.
